test_isoformat: test the Timestamp.isoformat method with various timespec values like auto, seconds, nanoseconds, hours, minutes, milliseconds, microseconds
test_repr: test Timestamp repr output includes date string, timezone info, and excludes freq, and is evaluable back to the original Timestamp
test_timestamp_pprint: test pprint.pformat of nested objects containing Timestamp instances produces expected formatted output
test_to_timestamp_repr_is_code: test Timestamp repr strings are valid Python code that eval back to the original Timestamp instances across multiple timezones
test_repr_matches_pydatetime: test Timestamp str representation matches stdlib datetime str for date, datetime, and datetime with timezone from stdlib and dateutil
